verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Metronome stores raw data for revenue recognition and exports billing data to a data warehouse so users can build their own reports. That warehouse export is the bolted-on BI path the story rejects. No evidence shows native MRR, churn, cohort retention, or LTV analytics computed inside the product.

support.subject: As a founder, I get MRR, churn, cohort retention, and LTV analytics computed from the billing source of truth, not a bolted-on BI export
